profile.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer

workExperiences.jobTitle: Senior Staff Software Engineer, Platform and Reliability
descriptions: Led the design and rollout of a multi-region platform serving millions of requests while maintaining strict reliability and recovery objectives.
Created reusable deployment, observability, security, and incident response capabilities adopted by more than thirty product teams.
Mentored senior engineers and partnered with product, security, compliance, and infrastructure leaders on multi-year technical strategy.
Reduced deployment lead time and improved change failure rate through progressive delivery, automated verification, and safer rollback workflows.
Established service ownership standards, operational reviews, capacity planning, and reliability scorecards across the engineering organisation.
Migrated a large monolithic application into independently deployable services without interrupting critical customer workflows.
Designed event-driven integration patterns and data migration tooling for a complex portfolio of enterprise applications.
Introduced distributed tracing, structured logging, and service-level objectives for business-critical systems.
Coordinated architecture decisions across application, data, infrastructure, and security teams.
Built internal libraries and reference implementations that improved consistency across dozens of services.
Delivered web and mobile products for customers in finance, healthcare, logistics, and public services.
Led discovery, technical design, implementation, release planning, and post-launch improvement.
Supported engineers through code review, pairing, technical workshops, and structured career development.
Improved automated testing and continuous delivery practices across multiple concurrent product teams.
Developed and maintained customer-facing applications, internal tools, integrations, and reporting systems.
Worked directly with customers to clarify requirements, diagnose production issues, and plan incremental improvements.
Created automated build and deployment processes for previously manual release workflows.

educations.degree: Bachelor of Engineering with Honours in Software Engineering
descriptions: Final-year research project on fault-tolerant distributed applications.

educations.degree: Advanced programmes in architecture, security, reliability, leadership, and cloud engineering
descriptions: Ongoing professional development through formal courses, industry conferences, and independent study.

Introduced automated failover validation, capacity modelling, and disaster recovery exercises.

projects.project: Developer Experience and Delivery Safety Programme

Reduced detection and recovery times for high-impact incidents.
Replaced fragile batch integrations with observable and recoverable event-driven workflows.
